notes.title: Performance Boost Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 👋

As we finish porting Toasterball to a little console from Nintendo (stay tuned for more info on that 👀), we had to do all sorts of optimizations that we decided to bring to the PC version too, so that our friends with smaller configs could enjoy Toasterball with a crisps 60 FPS as well 😀

Here are the small changes we made to this version:

1. Performance boost
We upgraded the asynchronous loading at the begining of the game to make it look smoother and reduce the time between the moment you click "Play" in Steam and the app launches.

We also did a lot (like... a month's worth of work) of invisible optimizations to our materials and lighting to make them run smoother (went from 25 to 60 FPS on that little console for example). Visually, basic shaders didn't change at all (well... apart for the fact that it runs way faster), but you might notice a slight change in the shadow system. We opted for a custom shading technique and had to remove the default Unity hard shadows that used to be applied everywhere. We replaced them with custom soft shadows below the toasters, the toasts and the ball. It might be less visible than before, but it's closer to the cartoonish style we had in mind for the game, it's way faster to run, and also better for gameplay readability!

2. Addition of traditional chinese
We also added the traditional chinese language in-game, in achievements descriptions and on the store page (another cool side-effect of our port).

Enjoy! 🔥

Les Crafteurs,
Alex, Simon, Joris & Théo

notes.title: TOASTERBALL’S FULL VERSION IS FINALLY AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36488440/8695ea0a4ac5b3b9591ab0c48a66a5bed011875d.pngSince Wednesday, May 3rd at 10am UTC, a big update is available on your Steam launcher!

It offers a significant number of additions, like new maps, a custom mode, or the ability to play against AI! In fact, it's almost Toasterball 2, but FREE! (well, for those who had already purchased the game in early access, of course, let’s not exaggerate)

We've already talked about it in the devlogs (here, here and here),  but we decided to do like the grown up devs do and detail all these new features of the final version here!

We recommend that you stay until the end, there's a little surprise! (No really.)
(AND DON'T CHEAT, I SEE YOU THERE STARTING TO SCROLL)
[previewyoutube=7KS7p5TQTKI;full][/previewyoutube]

New features

Launch intro

 Added a new logo animation for Les Crafteurs (formerly known as Couch Game Crafters)

Main Menu

 Added the Athletes Menu
 Overall UI revision

Lobby

 Tutorial with pictures on the whiteboard
 Updated "How to Play?" video

Classic Mode

 New team and role selection menu (attack/defense)
 Ability to add AI-controlled athletes and play solo with/against them
 New map selection menu, with 4 new maps and an update to the original Stadium

Custom Mode

A new mode to fully customize your game sessions:

 Variants selection, chosen in order or randomly
 Map selection, chosen in order or randomly

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36488440/81d4fb41963e09ff9f1e7cc969cdb68475093835.gif

During play

 New VS screen with athlete background
 New intro cinematics for each map, with dedicated music
 Changed goals: a system of three breakable panels for more intense and balanced matches
 Polished physics (jumps and toaster movements)
 Polished ball behavior (acceleration over time)
 New replay system (with multiple controllable cameras)
 A lot of new variants (we'll let you discover them yourself, hehe)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36488440/096a419ad5e49ebee7376402a5351ea24f49bd84.gif

Athletes Menu

 Display of each athlete attributes (description, locker, background)
 You’ll finally be able to see the back of the toasters

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36488440/2ce34bbd3072602fdb4a39ff8bd1b4bde235e517.png

Options

 8 new languages available (plus a really special one)
 UI options
 AI difficulty slider
 New secret codes
 New sound settings and volume test

Credits

 Updated credits page (addition of adorable & awesome people)

General UX

 Removed mouse control
 Added buttons to hold down to navigate menus
 New loading screens
 Steam Cloud Saving
 Removal of Tikhon 

Steam

 Added a ton of achievements
 Added collectible cards


We really hope you’ll enjoy this update and that it will be an opportunity to do some crazy tournaments!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36488440/722df3e8b8637782e410d3c18673e88ca7911ad2.gif

Help us get the word out!

This is all great, but now we need the world to notice us! 
And that's where you come in!

After getting your copy of Toasterball, please don't hesitate to leave us a positive review. Steam seems to LOVE that.
And of course, if money’s tight and you can’t buy the game right now, feel free to add the game to your wishlist! It doesn't cost anything and it also helps us a lot to gain visibility on Steam!


Thank you

Toasterball has been with us for 5 and a half years now. This project has taught us so much and still has the power to surprise us, to bring us amazing experiences and crazy opportunities.

As our first game, you can imagine the immense relief and pride we feel in finally delivering it to you and sharing it with the world.

Thank you again for your support, kindness, and enthusiasm.

The next step for us will be to [strike]sleep for a few days[/strike] port Toasterball to the Nintendo Switch, and then start working on a new project that we can't wait to share with you!

❤ Suivre Toasterball · ❤ Suivre Les Crafteurs

A little gift (or is it?!)

All right, as promised, since you stuck around until the end, here's a little secret for you: [spoiler]we've hidden 4 Toasterball Steam Keys in our latest videos.[/spoiler]

Good luck! (join our Discord to discuss your leads)



https://store.steampowered.com/app/1142810/Toasterball/

See you soon!

Les Crafteurs,
Alexandre, Simon, Joris & Théo

notes.title: Toasterball 1.6.0: Electric Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=40vEck6Cn8E;full][/previewyoutube]


Here are the new features on this little update:


1. New variant:  Electric Slabs ⚡💡
Description: Try not to get electrocuted! There’s a moving light bulb on the ceiling, and electric slabs on the floor. Every few seconds, an electric arc will appear between a random slab and the bulb, creating a deadly laser that you must avoid or you will explode! Yay, electrical hazard!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36488440/a3c320f4d524efbb62ac1834712a614e25517363.png


2. Dynamic music system 🎶
We added a new dynamic music system, that will add little varieties to the music depending of the variant you are in. Not all variants are covered but we tried it on the pong one (with an 8bits version of the main theme) and the ice one.


3. Secret codes 🎁
We implemented a secret code system you can access via the options menu. This will allow us to put secret unlockable stuff like toasters of your favorite twitch streamers, or secret modes to unlock. For now, let’s just say there’s little surprise in the dev letter on the start menu! (Also join our Discord for more codes!)


4. Other cool things
And then there’s the usual stuff: bug fixes, little tweaks on the physics system, etc. Amongst other things, here’s what we did:

 Fixed the basketball variant bug where the ball could go though the hoop and not trigger a goal,
 Added more bounce to the basketball so it’s easier to score,
 The ball will now accelerate way more as the point goes on,
 The ball should not get stuck sliding on the pong paddle anymore,
 The “Claustrophobia” variant (ceiling of death) should now last a little bit longer,
 The bomb ball will now explode faster and faster.
